name: City of San Marino (San Marino)
description: A horizontal bicolour of white over light blue, charged at the centre with the arms of the castello — the three towers of Monte Titano above the word 'LIBERTAS' — with 'SAN MARINO' written vertically at the hoist.
history: The flag of the castello of the City of San Marino, the republic's capital, in the national white and blue with the three towers. No adoption date has been published.

features.role: the three towers of Monte Titano
